name: 73116 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73116 (Oklahoma City) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73116 (Oklahoma City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 73116 (Oklahoma City) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.1 times the typical level).
